name: Kadowaki Ayumu
source:
Ayumu is a passionate Shogi player first, self-proclaimed "King" and leader of the Shogi Club (the only true member), reluctant runner second. He was a relationer last year, and relayed information to [url=/c35853]Heath[/url] and [url=/c35851]Hozumi[/url] in the 2-on-2 race. He then contemplated quitting the team and the Shogi Club because he has no talent as a runner.

[From [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Prince_of_Stride]Wikipedia[/url]]
